characters.name: Birbal
characters.description: a wise, calm advisor of Emperor Akbar with a neatly trimmed beard and simple white robe

characters.name: Emperor Akbar
characters.description: the great Mughal emperor wearing a jeweled crown, royal robe and a richly embroidered turban

characters.name: The Thief
characters.description: a nervous, ordinary-looking man in a plain brown tunic with worried eyes

scenes.narration: In the great kingdom of Akbar, a robbery left the royal treasury empty.
Every suspect was summoned to the grand Mughal court, where Emperor Akbar sat in silence.

dialogue.speaker: Emperor Akbar
dialogue.line: Bring in the accused. Today, truth will be revealed.

scenes.narration: Clever Birbal stepped forward and handed each suspect a wooden stick.

dialogue.speaker: Birbal
dialogue.line: Take home this stick tonight. The thief's own stick will grow two inches by dawn.

scenes.narration: That night, the suspects slept uneasily. Only one man could not rest.
By candlelight, the thief took his knife and cut two inches off the end of his own stick.

dialogue.speaker: The Thief
dialogue.line: If it grows overnight, mine will stand out. I must trim it short.

scenes.narration: At dawn, Birbal inspected every stick laid upon the marble floor.
One stick was clearly two inches shorter than all the rest.
Birbal pointed straight at the nervous man in brown.

dialogue.speaker: Birbal
dialogue.line: Only a guilty man would have cut his stick short last night. He is the thief.

scenes.narration: The thief's confession silenced the court, and wisdom had spoken once more.
